description: Find live events on shapargullay (Pakistan): by words, city, category, when and price. Returns upcoming events soonest first with their page links for booking.

category.description: concerts, qawwali, comedy, theatre, workshops, food, kids, festivals, art, online.

city.description: A Pakistani city, e.g. Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad. Use list_cities for the cities with events.

limit.description: How many events to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

max_price_pkr.description: Cheapest ticket at most this many rupees.

online_only.description: Only online events (joined by link, no venue).

query.description: Words to match: performer, event name, venue, organizer or theme, e.g. "qawwali", "Zaryab Malik", "stand-up".

when.description: A time window in Pakistan time.

name: search_events
title: Search events
